sloka: लक्ष्मणस्तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।ब्राह्ममस्त्रं प्रयोक्ष्यामि वधार्थं सर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ६.८०.३७ ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastu susaṅkruddho bhrātaraṁ vākyamabravīt।brāhmamastraṁ prayokṣyāmi vadhārthaṁ sarvarakṣasām ।। 6.80.37 ।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana also, enraged, spoke to his brother, saying," I will kill all the Rakshasas using the weapon of Brahma."
